scope.evidence: Only DiscordOpsAlert, config/services.php, .env.example, the two ops docs named in the task and the existing DiscordOpsAlertTest are touched; every hunk serves the task.

issues.explanation: conventions.md:103 requires a Keep a Changelog entry under [Unreleased], but the change updates the env/config docs without adding a changelog entry.
Valid-id boundary coverage uses only 18- and 20-digit ids (no plain 17-digit id), and no case combines an invalid id with an over-long alert, though the core behavior is otherwise well covered.

review.summary: The change adds an optional DISCORD_MENTION_ID / services.discord.mention_id setting, validates it as a 17-20 digit snowflake, and appends '<@ID>' on its own line while reserving room for it within the 1800-character truncation. It is implemented cleanly in the existing DiscordOpsAlert with focused Pest coverage and updated env/ops documentation. It would be approved with nits: the required CHANGELOG entry is missing and valid-id boundary coverage is slightly incomplete.
